title: Read the whole ridge path off one SVD
brief: Compute the per-direction shrink factors, turn them into the ridge weights for every lambda at once, and count the degrees of freedom each lambda leaves.
hints: shrink_factors: build the denominator s[None, :] ** 2 + lambdas[:, None], shape (m, r). Where it is exactly 0 (a zero singular value at lambda 0) return 0 instead of dividing, for example with np.divide(num, den, out=np.zeros_like(den), where=den > 0).
ridge_svd_path: compute U.T @ y once, multiply it by the (m, r) shrink factors, then multiply by Vt on the right. The result has shape (m, d).

effective_degrees_of_freedom: each direction contributes s ** 2 / (s ** 2 + lam). Sum over the direction axis (the last one) so an array of lambdas gives one number per lambda, and skip 0 / 0 the same way as in shrink_factors.
